differences.a_observable: Dappled leaf shadows move across the tiles.
differences.b_observable: The lighting is static and uniform across the tiles.
differences.fix: Add an animated gobo to the main light source to simulate moving tree shadows.

differences.a_observable: The corners of the frame are blurred due to shallow depth of field.
differences.b_observable: The corners of the frame are sharp and in focus.
differences.fix: Enable depth of field on the camera and adjust focus to blur the corners.

differences.a_observable: The yellow Recurly tile is highly saturated with a warm golden hue.
differences.b_observable: The yellow Recurly tile is less saturated with a cooler greenish-yellow hue.
differences.fix: Adjust the yellow material color to increase warmth and saturation.

json.highest_impact_fix: Add animated gobo shadows to the light source to replicate the dappled leaf shadows visible in the reference.
